topology_reasoning.device_identification: Four-port orthogonal waveguide crossing / compact multimode crossing. Two single-mode access waveguides cross at 90 degrees through a common expanded central multimode region.
topology_reasoning.operation: The narrow guides adiabatically expand into a broad central region so the fundamental field can pass across the crossing with reduced diffraction and lower interaction with the orthogonal arm; the symmetric vertical and horizontal body keeps the crossing balanced.
topology_reasoning.image_observations: Black material fills four narrow ports about 0.50 um wide at the footprint edges. Both axes broaden through curved shoulders to an approximately 2.5 um wide central neck near +/-1 um, then merge into an 8 um by 8 um shared crossing silhouette. The shape is close to the union of two identical variable-width waveguide paths rotated by 90 degrees.
topology_reasoning.implementation_plan: Use only primitive taper segments plus boolean union. Build a horizontal chain of tapers with top-level widths sampled from the bitmap; build a vertical chain with the same profile rotated by 90 degrees; boolean-or the two chains on layer (1,0). Write lengths.json from the primitive path extents, and expose horizontal_extra_length_um as the knob used for verify_knob_response.

iterations.change_made: Initial primitive reconstruction: boolean union of horizontal and vertical taper chains using bitmap-sampled widths snapped to the GDSFactory 0.002 um port grid; stopped because IoU exceeded 0.85.
